parameter.name: Assists
parameter.description: Last pass of a player who passes the ball to a teammate who scores

parameter.name: 2 vs 1 with goalkeeper card
parameter.description: 2 vs 1 with goalkeeper card is activated

parameter.name: Header Clearances
parameter.description: Ball clearances with headers from dangerous areas

parameter.name: Successful Crosses
parameter.description: Crosses whose next touch is from a teammate.

parameter.name: Successful Crosses (%)
parameter.description: Percentage of crosses whose next touch is from a teammate.

parameter.name: Total Red Cards
parameter.description: Total red cards, as sum of direct red and double yellow

parameter.name: Successful Dribbles
parameter.description: Dribbling one or more opponents maintaining possession of the ball.

parameter.name: Successful Dribbles (%)
parameter.description: Percentage of dribbling maintaining possession of the ball.

parameter.name: Duels
parameter.description: Duel for ball control between two players: includes also aerial duels and tackles

parameter.name: Duels Lost
parameter.description: Total duels lost (includes aerial duels and tackles)

parameter.name: Successful Tackle Duels
parameter.description: Tackle duels that are successful, stopping opponent advancement (possession gain not required)

parameter.name: Duels Won
parameter.description: Action attributed to the player / team who gains possession after a duel

parameter.name: Offsides
parameter.description: Action attributed to the offside player / team

parameter.name: Goals
parameter.description: Goals and opponent own goals combined

parameter.name: Goals (including tie-breaking shootout)
parameter.description: Goals and opponent own goals combined including goals scored in the tie-breaking shootout series

parameter.name: Goals Conceded Goals (including tie-breaking shootout)
parameter.description: Total goals conceded including goals scored in the tie-breaking shootout series

parameter.name: Golden Goals
parameter.description: Goals and opponent own goals combined scored in a "golden goal" situation (after which the game ends)

parameter.name: Penalty Golden Goals
parameter.description: Penalty goals scored in a "golden goal" situation (after which the game ends)

parameter.name: Shootout Golden Goals
parameter.description: Shootout goals scored in a "golden goal" situation (after which the game ends)

parameter.name: Goal Frequency
parameter.description: Average ball possession time to score a goal

parameter.name: Goal Conceded Frequency
parameter.description: Average ball possession time for the opponent to score a goal

parameter.name: % Goal Conversion
parameter.description: Percentage of goals scored over total attempted shots

parameter.name: Intercepetions
parameter.description: Ball intercepted by a player, regardless of being a recovery or not

parameter.name: Intercepetions in own box
parameter.description: Ball intercepted by a player in their own box, regardless of being a recovery or not

parameter.name: Successful key passes
parameter.description: Key Pass whose next touch is from a teammate.

parameter.name: Successful passes
parameter.description: Passes whose next touch is from a teammate.

parameter.name: Successful Passes (%)
parameter.description: Percentage of passes whose next touch is from a teammate.

parameter.name: Balls Played
parameter.description: Total balls played by the team

parameter.name: Lost Balls
parameter.description: Lost balls involving a definitive change of possession

parameter.name: % Lost Balls over Played Balls
parameter.description: Percentage of lost balls over played balls

parameter.name: Possessions recovered
parameter.description: Recovered ball which involves a definitive change of possession.

parameter.name: Goalkeeper Saves
parameter.description: Movement of the goalkeeper who blocks or rejects a shot towards the goal.

parameter.name: Goalkeeper Saves on Box Shots
parameter.description: Goalkeeper saves on shots taken from inside the penalty area

parameter.name: Goalkeeper Saves on Outside Shots
parameter.description: Goalkeeper saves on shots taken from outside the penalty area

parameter.name: Penalties Missed Saved (excluded president)
parameter.description: Penalties missed saved or parried by opponent goalkeeper (excluded president)

parameter.name: President Penalties Missed Saved
parameter.description: President penalties saved or parried by opponent goalkeeper

parameter.name: President Penalties Missed on Woodwork
parameter.description: President penalties missed by hitting the woodwork

parameter.name: Saved Penalties
parameter.description: Movement of the goalkeeper who blocks or rejects a penalty shot

parameter.name: Saved Shoot-out
parameter.description: Movement of the goalkeeper who blocks or rejects a shoot-out shot

parameter.name: Shots
parameter.description: Attempt towards the opponent's goal with the intention of scoring.

parameter.name: Shots Blocked
parameter.description: Shots attempted which get blocked or deflected by opponents outfield players

parameter.name: Shots Frequency
parameter.description: Average ball possession time before taking a shot

parameter.name: Shots on Target
parameter.description: Shot that ends in the target of the opponent's goal

parameter.name: Shots on Woodwork
parameter.description: Shots hitting the post or the crossbar

parameter.name: Shots Conceded
parameter.description: Event attributed to the goalkeeper facing an opponent's attempt

parameter.name: Shot Conceded Frequency
parameter.description: Average ball possession time for the opponent to take a shot

parameter.name: Goalkeeper Claims
parameter.description: Goalkeeper claims on crosses or loose balls. Clearances and parries are also considered claims

parameter.name: Failed Goalkeeper Claims
parameter.description: Failed goalkeeper claims on crosses or loose balls, with the ball being missed totally or almost

parameter.name: Goalkeeper Punch Claims
parameter.description: Goalkeeper clears the ball by punching it away

parameter.name: Expected goals (xG)
parameter.description: Sum of the scoring probabilities of shots taken. Such probabilities rely on the position the ball was shot from.
